Hi, thank you for your report! (and sorry for the delay)

I cannot replicate this on 4.6.stable, Fedora 43, GNOME 49.2 but I recently received multiple reports with the same error.

The compositor can tell the client to choose its own size by supplying a 0 in the respective dimension during a window configuration event. It looks like this value slipped out and even got saved into the window restore logic.

That might also explain why I can't replicate it, as window restoring is temporarily disabled on the latest release (see #113656 and #116308).
I've renamed the issue to be easier to find for future users. Please don't hesitate to correct me if the new title is incorrect.

Heh, while working on a related thing I think I figured out what's going on:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/778cf54dabd8a9e25b698a87036ab8604183f303/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L1424-L1426

As you might have noticed, nothing stops a compositor from reporting one dimension as 0, yet the code assumes otherwise, oops 😅

I'm hitting this consistently on Niri Wayland compositor:

Godot version: 4.6.1.stable.official
OS/Compositor: Debian 13 / Niri (Wayland, no X11 available)
GPU: Intel Mesa Intel(R) Graphics (ARL), OpenGL 4.6 Core Profile, Mesa 26.0.0-1

but only with Client-Side Decorations (CSD) - custom window title bar - this is likely caused by improper window size calculation within Godot wrt CSD.

## Reproducer

- Create new project.
- Save a scene.
- Reload Current Project
- Every subsequent run ends with


```
[3621047.861] {Display Queue} wl_display#1.error(wp_viewport#32, 0, "negative or zero values in width or height")
ERROR: Wayland protocol error 0 on interface wp_viewport@32.
   at: _poll_events_thread (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:3349)

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.1.stable.official (14d19694e0c88a3f9e82d899a0400f27a24c176e)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
[1] /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x40a70) [0x7f1b304f9a70] (??:0)
[2] godot() [0x4ec3d8] (??:0)

-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --

```

Full log: [godot_wayland_debug.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25846383/godot_wayland_debug.log)

## Likely Cause

During reload, the editor transitions to a small loading window 302×37 px. The CSD titlebar occupies the full 37 px of window height. The editor then calls wp_viewport.set_destination(302, 0) — passing height 0 — which is a Wayland protocol violation. The compositor sends back a fatal protocol error and the process crashes with signal 4.

Relevant Wayland protocol trace from WAYLAND_DEBUG=1:

```
  # Normal editor — valid dimensions
  -> xdg_surface#49.set_window_geometry(0, -37, 1262, 1032)
  -> wp_viewport#32.set_destination(1262, 995)

  # Reload transition — loading window is 302×37, CSD titlebar consumes all 37 px
  -> wp_viewport#32.set_destination(302, 0)        ← height 0, invalid
  -> xdg_surface#49.set_window_geometry(0, -37, 302, 37)

  # Compositor rejects it
  wl_display#1.error(wp_viewport#32, 0, "negative or zero values in width or height")
  ERROR: Wayland protocol error 0 on interface wp_viewport@32.
     at: _poll_events_thread (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:3349)
```

The loading window height (37 px) equals exactly the CSD titlebar offset (y=-37 in set_window_geometry), so the content viewport height computes to zero.

With CSD disabled the crash does not occur.

## Workaround

Before this gets fixed in Godot, workaround is to not use custom titlebar (CSD - Client-Side Decorations) for Godot editor, for example on Niri with this config option:

```
prefer-no-csd
```
